about_the_game:
Welcome to a colorful and unpredictable world where the classic "roll-and-move" board game mechanics come to life in a fun multiplayer adventure!

Gather your friends and head to a virtual game board full of surprises, interactive characters, and devious traps.

What awaits you:

  • Classic with a Twist: Roll the dice and move across a vibrant 3D board, but be ready for anything!

  • Cards Rule Everything: Use an action card deck to change the course of the game. Double your roll, block an opponent for a turn, reduce their result, or play another cunning trick!

  • A Living, Interactive World: The tiles hold not just numbers, but whole events:

    • Fight a Guard by using a Sword card.

    • Haggle with the Merchant to trade cards for gold coins.

    • Open a Chest to find treasure... or a surprise!

    • And this is just a fraction of what the game board holds!

  • Fun Multiplayer: The perfect party game for friends! Sabotage, deceive, and laugh at your friends' misfortunes in a light-hearted and friendly atmosphere.

  • Charming Graphics: Bright, cartoonish 3D graphics and funny animations create a unique festive mood.

Roll the dice first and find out which of your friends is out of luck today

name: Lucky Throw Party
short_description: Dive into a fun cartoon universe where the board game comes to life! Roll the dice, use sneaky cards to mess with your friends, and interact with dozens of crazy objects on your path. Who will be the first to reach the finish line, surviving all the surprises and betrayals?
